Former Chief Executive Officer; appointed Chairman of the Board
Interim Chief Executive Officer; will continue as Chief Technology Officer
Resignation effective September 4, 2026; appointment as Chairman effective August 28, 2026
Resignation not due to any disagreement with the Company; acknowledged as "Good Reason" under Retention Agreement
Replaced as CEO by Interim CEO Thomas R. Szoke
Will continue to serve as director; amendments to Retention Agreement provide stipends, equity grants, extended option exercisability, and contingent cash payment upon Corporate Transaction

Co-founder; age 62; over 35 years of executive management, solutions engineering and operations experience; rejoined company March 9, 2023; CTO since April 2023; holds U.S. and international patents and pioneered key product lines
Appointed Chairman of the Board for remainder of current term
